content: झिल्ली .²1 A cricket; लूतातन्तुवितानसंवृतमुखी झिल्ली चिरं रोदिति <ls>Sūkti. 5. 19</ls>. .²2 A kind of musical instrument, cymbal. .²3 A parchment. .²4 The wick of a lamp. .²5 A cloth for applying unguents, colours <ab>&c.</ab> .²6 Sunshine. .²7 Light, lustre. .²8 Rice burnt by cooking in a sauce pan <ab>&c.</ab>
